caption:
A goal in your head has nowhere to live. Give it a page.

We're past the halfway mark of July, and here's the quiet truth about money goals: the ones that only live in your head tend to stay wishes. Written down, a goal becomes something you can actually work with — a number you can see, a date you're aiming for, a box you get to tick.

You don't need a new month, a new app, or a perfect plan to start. One page and one honest number tonight is enough. (The savings tracker in our planner was built for exactly this.)

📌 Save this for tonight — then write one goal down.
